component.name: horizontalButton
component.script:
function IsValid(value as Dynamic) as Boolean return (Type(value) <> "<uninitialized>" and value <> invalid) end function
function itemContentChanged() ' Ensure nodes exist (onChange can fire before init) if not isValid(m.itemImage) then m.itemImage = m.top.findNode("itemImage") end if if not isValid(m.itemText) then m.itemText = m.top.findNode("itemText") end if if not isValid(m.itemOutline) then m.itemOutline = m.top.findNode("outline") end if if not isValid(m.itemBackground) then m.itemBackground = m.top.findNode("background") end if if not isValid(m.itemFocusBackground) then m.itemFocusBackground = m.top.findNode("focusBackground") end if
ic = m.top.itemContent if isValid(ic) ' Text if isValid(m.itemText) if isValid(ic.labelText) and ic.labelText <> "" m.itemText.text = ic.labelText m.itemText.visible = true else m.itemText.text = "" m.itemText.visible = false end if if isValid(ic.fontUrl) and ic.fontUrl <> "" and isValid(m.itemText.font) m.itemText.font.uri = ic.fontUrl m.itemText.visible = true end if if isValid(ic.fontSize) and ic.fontSize <> "" and isValid(m.itemText.font) m.itemText.font.size = ic.fontSize m.itemText.visible = true end if end if
' Image if isValid(m.itemImage) if isValid(ic.posterUrl) and ic.posterUrl <> "" m.itemImage.uri = ic.posterUrl m.itemImage.visible = true else m.itemImage.uri = "" m.itemImage.visible = false end if end if
' Sizing w = 0 : h = 0 if isValid(ic.width) then w = ic.width end if if isValid(ic.height) then h = ic.height end if if isValid(m.itemOutline) then m.itemOutline.width = w m.itemOutline.height = h end if if isValid(m.itemBackground) then m.itemBackground.width = w - 4 m.itemBackground.height = h - 4 end if if isValid(m.itemFocusBackground) then m.itemFocusBackground.width = w - 4 m.itemFocusBackground.height = h - 4 end if if isValid(m.itemImage) then m.itemImage.width = w - 4 m.itemImage.height = h - 4 end if if isValid(m.itemText) then m.itemText.width = w - 4 m.itemText.height = h - 4 end if
' Colors outlineColor = "0xFFFFFFFF" bgBase = "0x000000" if isValid(ic.outlineColor) and len(ic.outlineColor) >= 8 then outlineColor = ic.outlineColor end if if isValid(ic.backgroundColor) and len(ic.backgroundColor) >= 8 then bgBase = Left(ic.backgroundColor, 8) end if if isValid(m.itemText) then m.itemText.color = Left(outlineColor, 8)+"99" end if if isValid(m.itemOutline) then m.itemOutline.color = outlineColor end if if isValid(m.itemBackground) then m.itemBackground.color = bgBase+"FF" end if if isValid(m.itemFocusBackground) then m.itemFocusBackground.color = bgBase+"AA" end if end if ' Re-apply focus styling after content updates so the active red box persists if isValid(m.top.isFocused) and m.top.isFocused then gotFocus() end if end function
function itemFocus() if m.top.focusPercent > .5 m.top.isFocused = true else m.top.isFocused = false end if end function function gotFocus() if m.top.isFocused m.itemBackground.color = m.top.itemContent.backgroundColor+"00" m.itemOutline.color = "0xC70039FF" m.itemText.color = Left(m.top.itemContent.outlineColor, 8)+"FF" else m.itemBackground.color = m.top.itemContent.backgroundColor+"FF" m.itemOutline.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.itemText.color = Left(m.top.itemContent.outlineColor, 8)+"99" end if end function function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean ' Intercept FF/RW when a control button has focus to prevent MarkupGrid edge-jumps if press = true if key = "fastforward" or key = "rewind" dir = 0 if key = "fastforward" then dir = 1 else dir = -1 ' Swallow the next directional key the platform may emit alongside FF/RW if key = "fastforward" then m.swallowNextNavKey = "right" else m.swallowNextNavKey = "left" scn = invalid try: scn = m.top.getScene() : catch e: scn = invalid : end try if isValid(scn) ' Try to call a handler on the scene; ignore if not present try: scn.callFunc("skipFromControlBar", dir) : catch e: end try end if return true end if if (key = "left" or key = "right") and isValid(m.swallowNextNavKey) if m.swallowNextNavKey = key m.swallowNextNavKey = invalid return true end if end if end if return false end function function init() m.itemImage = m.top.findNode("itemImage") m.itemText = m.top.findNode("itemText") m.itemOutline = m.top.findNode("outline") m.itemBackground = m.top.findNode("background") m.itemFocusBackground = m.top.findNode("focusBackground") m.swallowNextNavKey = invalid end function
